findings.currentPlan: Omgevingsplan Den Haag CVDR696341 remains the spatial/address layer.
findings.currentHousingRegulation: Huisvestingsverordening Den Haag 2023 is current in its version effective 01-04-2026. The 2026 amendment implements the Nota Woningvoorraad changes.
findings.roomRental: Up to 2 room tenants can be housed without an omzettingsvergunning. At 3+ persons an omzettingsvergunning is required. Current rules cap ordinary room occupation at 8 residents, require at least 18 m2 use area per resident, additional acoustic requirements at 5+ residents, and a use notification at 5+ rooms. Permits are limited by liveability-area eligibility, a 10% neighbourhood ceiling and 33.3% building/connected-row concentration.
findings.housingFormation: Building one independent dwelling into 2+ independent units requires woningvormingsvergunning; new units at least 35 m2, with liveability and parking-pressure tests. Current municipal page states EUR 575.35 and 8-week decision period.
findings.cadastre: Kadastral splitting may require a splitsingsvergunning. Application includes cadastral splitting drawing and detailed building-condition report; EUR 204.30 per formed apartment right, maximum EUR 3,750; 8 weeks plus possible 6-week extension.
findings.documents: Housing-regulation application at minimum identifies address/applicant, existing rooms/area and intended rooms/residents; municipality can demand more. Kadastral route has a concrete drawing/condition-report matrix.
findings.hospita: 2026 amendment creates permit exemption with mandatory electronic notification for qualifying hospitaverhuur; it is kept distinct from ordinary room occupation.
findings.currentness: Official Den Haag information published/updated in 2026 confirms the relaxation from 1 April 2026; older restrictive rules are not used as current state.
